===================================================================
Sky_Night01
Compiled by Jasper Carmack
August 28th 2021
===================================================================

Feel free to write me if you have any questions or feedback!
Email: JasperCarmack@gmail.com
Discord: Jasper Carmack#0156
Telegram: @JasperCarmack
Twitter: @JasperCarmack

Donations are always appreciated <3 I put a lot of hours into these
https://ko-fi.com/jaspercarmack
===================================================================

==================
ABOUT THIS FILE:
==================

A simple nighttime sky with crisp clouds and a bright moon.


==================
FOLDER CONTENTS:
==================

Maps - Contains a VMF map file with Light_Environment and Shadow values for the sky.
Materials - Contains materials in VMT and VTF form, ready to be used ingame.
MaterialSrc - Contains the source files for editing or compiling the materials as a VTF.
Raw - Contains raw output renders and source files.
TerragenSrc - Contains Terragen source files for the skybox.


==================
LICENCE:
==================

* You may not re-sell these textures either individually or as part of a pack, nor in original or modified form, without my express written permission.

* You are free to use this file for your own personal, and/or commercial games, mods and productions.

* You may redistribute this file as its original ZIP file (It must include the README.txt).

* You may use, compile, decompile, modify and alter this texture set, its source files or terragen file in any way you wish.

* Credit is not explicitly required, but is always appreciated!


Much peace and love
-Jasper
